Name: Grandchild's Farm II
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[size=4][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/2Jn9jeI.png[/img][/center][/size]

[font=Courier New][size=3]Grandchild's Farm II is a medium-sized farm with a pre-organized layout, which still gives enough room to give a personal touch to your farm. It's mainly meant for people who dislike making layouts, but still like to decorate or build enough Slime Hutches to take over the Valley.

To make your start on the new farm a bit easier, the smelly ol' Parsnips have been exchanged for 25 beautiful seeds of a crop, you'll certainly enjoy. The House also comes with a little extra, I'm sure you'll spot it immediately. 
[/size][/font]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/VW16KHU.png[/img][/center]

[font=Courier New][size=3]→ This map uses Custom Farm Loader (CFL), so it won't replace any of the existing farms. To use this farm, simply press the gear below the farm selection column and click on the Grandchild's Farm - press the red X to return to the former screen. Below the farm selection column "Grandchild's Farm II" should be selected and highlighted. If it doesn't appear make sure CFL and Grandchild's Farm is correctly installed!﻿

→ Every crop area has 5x5 layout (that's 25 spaces) so you can use Iridium Sprinklers on them.
The grass is not tillable, but you can put shrubs and bushes from Cornucopia and Wildflour Atelier there.
[s]Or you know even more Slime Hutches.[/s]

→ Below the crop field there's space for either 60 trellis crops (if you refuse to use a walk through trellis mod) or a cute little bee area.
If you're an avid user of automate, you can just put some chests down and let your bees do their thing, while you just wait for that delicious gold.
Further down you'll find a little tree area where you can fit about 24 of your favorite trees and make yourself a little orchard.

→ But, Lavliette, you ask, what are those eight dark grassy squares for? Can I plant crops there???
No, you fool! That's for the fishies. You put your fish ponds there - up to eight very lovely fish ponds. 

→ You've probably figures out where the barns, coops and silos go (also enjoy the free Blue Grass!) so I rather talk about those two big spaces right below the animal area. When I made this map, Slime Hutches were still big, bad and beautiful but 1.6 shrunk them down. But fret not dear reader, because now you can fit two Slime Hutches there! ...Well or maybe another Shed or you grab a lovely custom building like a Terrarium, or an Apiary? It's also a neat area for some additional cabins! (On a side note: This farm is not made with Multiplayer in mind, meaning there's no starting cabins, so you'd have to build them first)

→ Would you like to use your own custom fences? Well tough luck, 'cause mama ain't fixing them. The fences are matching the fences in town, so if you're running Way Back Pelican Town or any other town overhaul or recolour that touches the fences around town, all fences match! 
The bushes are decoration, meaning they won't carry berries and are simply there to look nice. :)

Yes, I know, walking to the crop field can be a tad annoying but there's other fun ways to circumvent that, which will be listed in the Recommandations section. [/size][/font]

[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bcVyP2V.png[/img][/center]

[font=Courier New][size=3][b]Disclaimer: These are suggestions - they aren't meant to be mandatory, but before you write a complaint, check out these mods first:
[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]NoClip Mode[/url] || [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21054]Jump Mod 
[/url]→ No fence will dare to stand in your way and no pesky Forageable will be left forgotten!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14434]Seasonal Outdoor Fences [/url]
→ Lets you use DustBeauty's beautiful fences all around town and on this farm! They match Yellog's Buildings very nicely and are also recommendable for other more toned-down building mods. 
[/size][/font]

[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/2Qi2pLP.png[/img][/center]

[font=Courier New][size=3][b][u]I have found a bug! How do I report it? [/u][/b]
Through the Bug Tab - please include a screenshot if it's a visual bug - and also describe what the problem is exactly.

If it's some other sort of bug, like the farm not loading in, please ask for assistence on the Stardew Valley Discord first.

I hardly look at my comments cause I got anxiety, so fair warning... you might be waiting a few weeks, if it's just some clipping issue. :D


[b][u]Can you add/remove [this random thing]?[/u][/b]
Short answer: No.
Long answer: If it also bothers me, I might remove or add something.
(Don't get your hopes up for the fences, I'll die on that hill)

Anything you couldn't play test?[/u][/b]
